options.text: I avoid using this stop because the crossings feel unsafe
I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
I feel safe and well protected by the crossing design and traffic controls

How does the quality of crossings (e.g. signals, bridges, or tunnels) near the stop influence your sense of safety?
en.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: I avoid using this stop because the crossings feel unsafe
en.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: I often feel unsafe when crossing to reach the stop
en.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: I sometimes change my route to use crossings that feel safer
en.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: I generally feel safe, but I still need to be careful when crossing
en.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: I feel safe and well protected by the crossing design and traffic controls

In che modo la qualità degli attraversamenti (ad es. semafori, ponti o sottopassaggi) vicino alla fermata influisce sulla tua percezione di sicurezza?
it.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Evito di utilizzare questa fermata perché gli attraversamenti mi sembrano pericolosi
it.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Spesso mi sento in pericolo quando attraverso la strada per raggiungere la fermata
it.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: A volte cambio percorso per utilizzare attraversamenti che mi sembrano più sicuri
it.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: In generale mi sento al sicuro, ma devo comunque prestare attenzione quando attraverso
it.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Mi sento al sicuro e ben protetto/a dalla progettazione degli attraversamenti e dai sistemi di regolazione del traffico

Comment la qualité des traversées, par exemple les feux, ponts ou tunnels près de l’arrêt, influence-t-elle votre sentiment de sécurité ?
fr.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: J’évite cet arrêt parce que les traversées me semblent dangereuses
fr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Je me sens souvent en danger lorsque je traverse pour rejoindre l’arrêt
fr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Je change parfois d’itinéraire pour utiliser une traversée qui me semble plus sûre
fr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: En général, je me sens en sécurité, mais je dois rester prudent(e) lorsque je traverse
fr.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Je me sens en sécurité et bien protégé(e) grâce à l’aménagement de la traversée et à la régulation du trafic

Wie beeinflusst die Qualität von Querungen, zum Beispiel Ampeln, Brücken oder Unterführungen in der Nähe der Haltestelle, Ihr Sicherheitsgefühl?
de.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Ich vermeide diese Haltestelle, weil sich die Querungen unsicher anfühlen
de.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Ich fühle mich beim Überqueren auf dem Weg zur Haltestelle oft unsicher
de.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Ich ändere manchmal meine Route, um eine Querung zu nutzen, die sich sicherer anfühlt
de.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Im Allgemeinen fühle ich mich sicher, muss beim Überqueren aber trotzdem vorsichtig sein
de.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Ich fühle mich durch die Gestaltung der Querung und die Verkehrsregelung sicher und gut geschützt

Durağın yakınındaki geçişlerin, örneğin trafik ışıkları, köprüler veya alt geçitlerin, kalitesi güvenlik hissinizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Geçişler güvensiz hissettirdiği için bu durağı kullanmaktan kaçınırım
tr.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Durağa ulaşmak için karşıya geçerken sık sık kendimi güvensiz hissederim
tr.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Daha güvenli hissettiren geçişleri kullanmak için bazen güzergâhımı değiştiririm
tr.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Genellikle kendimi güvende hissederim, ancak karşıya geçerken yine de dikkatli olmam gerekir
tr.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Geçiş tasarımı ve trafik düzenlemeleri sayesinde kendimi güvende ve iyi korunmuş hissederim

کیفیت گذرگاه‌ها، مانند چراغ، پل یا زیرگذر نزدیک ایستگاه، چه اثری بر احساس امنیت شما دارد؟
fa.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: به دلیل ناامن بودن گذرگاه‌ها از این ایستگاه استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: هنگام عبور برای رسیدن به ایستگاه اغلب احساس ناامنی می‌کنم
fa.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: گاهی مسیرم را تغییر می‌دهم تا از گذرگاهی استفاده کنم که امن‌تر به نظر می‌رسد
fa.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: در مجموع احساس امنیت می‌کنم، اما هنگام عبور همچنان باید مراقب باشم
fa.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: به دلیل طراحی گذرگاه و کنترل ترافیک احساس امنیت و محافظت خوبی دارم

Hogyan befolyásolja a megálló közelében lévő átkelőhelyek, például jelzőlámpák, hidak vagy aluljárók minősége a biztonságérzetét?
hu.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: Kerülöm ezt a megállót, mert az átkelés nem tűnik biztonságosnak
hu.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: Gyakran érzem magam bizonytalannak, amikor a megállóhoz vezető úton át kell kelnem
hu.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: Néha módosítom az útvonalat, hogy biztonságosabbnak tűnő átkelőhelyet használjak
hu.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: Általában biztonságban érzem magam, de átkeléskor továbbra is óvatosnak kell lennem
hu.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: Az átkelőhely kialakítása és a forgalomszabályozás miatt biztonságban és jól védve érzem magam

كيف تؤثر جودة المعابر، مثل الإشارات أو الجسور أو الأنفاق القريبة من المحطة، في شعورك بالأمان؟
ar.#I avoid using this stop because the cro: أتجنب استخدام هذه المحطة لأن المعابر تبدو غير آمنة
ar.#I often feel unsafe when crossing to re: غالبًا ما أشعر بعدم الأمان عند العبور للوصول إلى المحطة
ar.#I sometimes change my route to use cros: أغيّر طريقي أحيانًا لاستخدام معبر يبدو أكثر أمانًا
ar.#I generally feel safe, but I still need: أشعر بالأمان عمومًا، لكنني ما زلت بحاجة إلى الحذر عند العبور
ar.#I feel safe and well protected by the c: أشعر بالأمان والحماية الجيدة بسبب تصميم المعبر وتنظيم حركة المرور
